title: FlowFactoryOutboxItem
description: One GitHub write the factory engine recorded before running it: <factory dir>/jobs/issue-<N>/outbox/<id>.json for a job, or <P9 probe folder>/outbox/<id>.json for the P9 probe intent. Its intent_recorded line in the events file beside it holds the sha256 a later check compares with. Items are never deleted. The engine checks it with bin/_flow_factory_schema.py, which supports only the keywords this file uses.

id.description: The intent id, fixed before any POST and equal to the engine marker's event= value: issue-N-j<seq>-<row>-<k> for a job (<row> is the state table row, or note for a write no row makes), probe-p9-<n> for the P9 probe intent.

job.description: The job key; null for the P9 probe intent.

row.description: The state table row whose effect makes the write; null for a note and for the P9 probe intent.

state_at_write.description: The state the write belongs to: the row's target state, or the job's state for a stay row and a note; null for the P9 probe intent.

ref.description: The comment id the write answers, or null.

kind.description: The write's kind. assign_label is the assignment and the in-progress label as one command.

key.description: The tier keys the write counts under.

argv.description: The command, run without a shell.

body_file.description: The body file's path relative to the outbox folder, or null when the write has no body. The path may not start with / or hold a .. segment, so it cannot name a file outside the outbox folder.

sha256.description: sha256 over the argv elements and the body bytes, each followed by a NUL byte except the body.

status.description: recorded until it runs; pending_confirm for a notice waiting on a confirm-keyed tier; confirmed once a person confirmed that notice at a terminal; sent once it ran or was found on GitHub; dropped when the state table dropped it.

effect.description: What the write left on GitHub once seen (one of comment_id, sha, pr, label), else null.

tier_key.description: The keys of tiers in the settings schema.
